description.title: כיסוי תיקון פגוש
description.summary: This table details the coverage for repairing vehicle bumpers, specifying which parts are included and the conditions for service. It outlines the scope of repair under the insurance policy.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת את הכיסוי לתיקון פגוש ברכב, ומפרטת אילו חלקים כלולים בתנאי הפוליסה ואילו תנאים חלים על השירות. הכיסוי מסופק על ידי מבצע התיקון, בהתאם למפרט הפוליסה, וכולל תיקון או החלפת פגוש פלסטיק חיצוני ופנימי. ניתן לחפש מידע על הכיסוי לפי סוג הפגוש, החלקים הכלולים (כגון גריל קדמי, כיסוי פנס ערפל) והגבלות האחריות המפורטות במפרט. החלקים הכלולים בכיסוי הם פגוש חיצוני, גריל קדמי, פלסטיק חלת דבש, מוטות צד, כיסוי פנס ערפל, סנורים ומצלמות, קישוטים מקוריים, ספוילר תחתון ותושבות ללוחית רישוי.

28.2.2 The service according to this cover will be provided for unexpected damage to the vehicle bumper as follows:
28.2.2.1  The cover will apply only to external and internal plastic parts, constituting part of the fender and are related to returning the fender to its original condition according to the manufacturer's specifications only, such as: external fender, front grille, plastic honeycombs and other internal reinforcements, insofar as same are made of plastic, Styrofoam for the fender, side bars, fog covers, central grille, sensors and cameras of all types, various ornaments (as long as same are original from the factory and not a local addition), lower spoiler, sensors -excluding the control unit, license plate mounts, supports (including lamp 'whiskers').
28.2.2.2  The cover will be valid even if damage is caused in the same event to additional part(s) of the vehicle, provided that it is possible to repair the bumper damage without disassembling additional parts of the vehicle and under comprehensive insurance only, as well as receipt of confirmation regarding nonfiling of a claim from the insurance company and subject to the limit of liability stated in the specification for this cover .
28.2.2.3  The bumper to be repaired will be a replacement bumper. In the event that the Executor of the repair is unable to find a corresponding product as aforementioned, the executor of the repair will be entitled, at his discretion, and will be entitled to manufacture and/or import and/or repair this product on behalf of the insured, or to replace the damaged product with an original product made by the vehicle manufacturer or by a manufacturer authorized to manufacture on behalf of the vehicle manufacturer.

28.2.2.2  The cover will be valid even if damage is caused in the same event to additional part(s) of the vehicle, provided that it is possible to repair the bumper damage without disassembling additional parts of the vehicle and under comprehensive insurance only, as well as receipt of confirmation regarding nonfiling of a claim from the insurance company and subject to the limit of liability stated in the specification for this cover .
28.2.2.3  The bumper to be repaired will be a replacement bumper. In the event that the Executor of the repair is unable to find a corresponding product as aforementioned, the executor of the repair will be entitled, at his discretion, and will be entitled to manufacture and/or import and/or repair this product on behalf of the insured, or to replace the damaged product with an original product made by the vehicle manufacturer or by a manufacturer authorized to manufacture on behalf of the vehicle manufacturer.
